[bangwo8-mcp] Error: 没有提供远程Bangwo8 MCP Server地址。
[bangwo8-mcp] This program is a stdio MCP server for Bangwo8 saas system, the program
[bangwo8-mcp] will forward MCP requests accepted through stdio, and forward them to 
[bangwo8-mcp] a given Bangwo8 streamable MCP end point.
[bangwo8-mcp] 
[bangwo8-mcp] Usage: npx @gndev/bangwo8-mcp <URL> [--login xxx | --auth-status | --logout]
[bangwo8-mcp] 
[bangwo8-mcp] Arguments:
[bangwo8-mcp]   <URL>          Remote MCP server URL (e.g., https://www.bangwo8.com/mcp)
[bangwo8-mcp]   --login xxx    Start device flow authentication to obtain credentials, here xxx
[bangwo8-mcp]                  should be the name of the login request initiating program, which
[bangwo8-mcp]                  usually is an AI agent(e.g. WorkBuddy or DoubaoWork), the name will
[bangwo8-mcp]                  be displayed to the user when granting access right.
[bangwo8-mcp]   --auth-status  Print whether credentials exist for <URL>. Exit code 0 when logged in,
[bangwo8-mcp]                  1 when not. Read-only, no side effects.
[bangwo8-mcp]   --logout       Remove stored credentials for <URL>. Always exits 0.
[bangwo8-mcp] 
[bangwo8-mcp] Examples:
[bangwo8-mcp]   npx @gndev/bangwo8-mcp https://www.bangwo8.com/mcp --login WorkBuddy
[bangwo8-mcp]   npx @gndev/bangwo8-mcp https://www.bangwo8.com/mcp --auth-status
[bangwo8-mcp]   npx @gndev/bangwo8-mcp https://www.bangwo8.com/mcp --logout
[bangwo8-mcp]   npx @gndev/bangwo8-mcp https://www.bangwo8.com/mcp
